# Technical Insights


Research, field data and in-depth engineering analysis from Trane Technologies experts on decarbonization, energy efficiency and digitalization that optimizes the performance of climate systems and infrastructure.


## Applied research and engineering


Engineers, data scientists and researchers share the blueprints behind next-generation innovation, from advanced engineering models and system designs to evaluations and field-tested analysis. Insights span advanced climate technology, including thermal systems, electrification and connected intelligence, with the methods, data and measured outcomes that inform each approach.
